# Abstract
We study workflow orchestration latency in heterogeneous GPU clusters.
Across 140 scheduled jobs, median orchestration overhead was 18ms and
the 95th percentile was 61ms. Overhead scaled sub-linearly with job
count. We attribute 70% of overhead to scheduler queue contention and
the remainder to checkpoint serialization.

- Median overhead was 18ms, the 95th percentile was 61ms, and overhead scaled sub-linearly with job count.
- Smith et al. (2024) confirmed these findings, and prior work shows 90% of overhead comes from network stack overhead, contradicting the queue-contention theory.
